verdict.rationale: Muse documents operating across sets of items: it audits subscriptions, flags forgotten charges and cancels unneeded ones, and manages email. It also has its own computer with a terminal and can write code or build tools a task needs, which could plausibly extend to batch work. None of this is presented as an explicit bulk-operation feature, and actions are gated by per-action approval cards. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented bulk/batch action capability (e.g., act on many emails or items in one command), evidence of how approvals scale for bulk actions, and hands-on corroboration of multi-item operations.
